title: Code unit inventory 0.1
description: One ported application's source code units and where each one goes. Version 0.1 only ever gains optional members; an incompatible revision is a new schema with a new $id and format. Objects are open: a producer may add members, and readers ignore the ones they do not know. Rules that relate members to each other (a translated unit names an artifact, any other unit gives a reason) are enforced by the scoreboard, not here.

sourceLoc.description: Lines in all inventoried source files, translated or not.

elapsedMinutes.description: Null when unknown; null is not zero.

modelTokens.description: Null when unknown; null is not zero.

trigger.description: What invokes the unit in the source system.

externalCalls.description: Declared calls that leave the application.

loc.description: Inclusive source lines of the unit.

target.description: The kind of Norn definition the unit maps to. Values in use: rule, transition, action, connector, widget, function, access, setup-only. Other values are allowed.

parityRecipe.description: The application's own name for how this unit's parity is established. Free text; no vocabulary is defined here.

status.description: translated: a Norn candidate exists and nornArtifactIds names it. fallback: the unit stays in source code, with a reason. setup-only: outside the runtime targets, with a reason. Other values are counted by the scoreboard under their own name and need a reason.

reason.description: Required by the scoreboard for every unit that is not translated.
